patterns: This morning’s macro print is the cluster: Bull Theory’s Q2 GDP 2.2% vs 1.5% (106,887 views), gold/silver +$230B, bitcoin through $85k, and $530B onto US stocks, with Ash Crypto on hike odds 70%→34% and unusual_whales on core PCE 3.0% vs 3.3%.

Remarks holds the sample’s impressions: the JPMorgan “DEI is not going to save you” post at 3,863,300 views, plus a Daily Mail CIA weather-control item at 209,015. A 6,024,979-view thread reply was dropped and not counted.

Tesla/SpaceX is the other lane: Sawyer Merritt on AT&T vs SpaceX satellite (399,017) and Tesla’s Q3 consensus (122,979); DogeDesigner on Starlink, Starship, and Vera Rubin; Not a Tesla App’s 2026.38 notes at 58,729.
